archetypes.name: dyn-fd-pinning
archetypes.rationale: Fd ownership and TOCTOU behavior changed in run-scoped progress writes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the progress_file fd-pinning changes for descriptor ownership, close-on-error paths, and symlink or parent-swap safety. Check that activate_run and append_breadcrumb_for_run never fall back to path-based writes for run-scoped artifacts and that best-effort behavior remains unchanged where required. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
